title: Optimize BM25 score map preallocation
constraints: Preserve BM25 scoring, result limiting, and ordering semantics
rationale: BM25 search accumulates scores into a document-id map after scanning posting lists for query terms. Collecting the matching posting lists first gives a safe capacity bound for the score map, reducing rehash growth during MATCH queries.
steps: Collect matching posting lists for query tokens
Return early when no query token has postings
Preallocate the score map from the summed posting-list length capped by known document count
Reuse collected posting lists for unchanged BM25 scoring
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in full-text MATCH searches without changing score calculation or result ordering.
